verdict.rationale: Notion markets AI Q&A with citations ('Get answers, instantly—with citations') and always-on agents working over workspace data, implying AI-generated insights/suggestions from user data, but the evidence is thin marketing copy without technical detail on how insights/suggestions are surfaced or their depth, and no independent/hands-on corroboration exists. missing for 10: detailed documentation of insight/suggestion mechanics, independent user reports validating AI-generated insights quality, and examples of proactive suggestions beyond Q&A.
